indicators.name: Machine stops in middle of cut and displays Machine Paused
indicators.description: The machine stops mid-cut and displays the Machine Paused message.

claim_evidence.quote: The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message “Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch Screen.

failure_link_evidence.quote: This is typically caused by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.

failure.name: intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
failure.description: An intermittent pause circuit in the stop discs triggers the unintentional pause.

claim_evidence.quote: This is typically caused by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.

actions.description: Adjust the pause plunger to set the required activation pressure.
actions.instruction_text: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure or loosen it to decrease activation pressure.

claim_evidence.quote: Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.

resolution_link_evidence.quote: Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.

indicators.name: Touch Screen buttons are out of alignment
indicators.description: Touch-screen commands activate only when the operator presses away from the displayed button.

claim_evidence.quote: Problem: The buttons on the Touch Screen are out of
alignment Description of Problem: The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen needs to be touched to activate the command.

failure_link_evidence.quote: The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen needs to be touched to activate the command.

failure.name: Touch screen calibration is required
failure.description: The touch screen requires calibration before its controls align with touch positions.

claim_evidence.quote: Touch screen calibration in required.

actions.name: complete touch screen calibration and save and exit
actions.description: Complete the touch-screen calibration procedure and save the calibration.
actions.instruction_text: Open the calibration screen, press the calibration cross targets, then select save and exit to complete calibration.

claim_evidence.quote: Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen to begin calibrating.
Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the cross as shown. The cross will reappear in the lower right corner. Press the center of the cross.
Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to complete calibration.

resolution_link_evidence.quote: Touch screen calibration in required. Proceed as follows.
Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to complete calibration.
